note: The release plan for the Product & Program page. Milestones hold stories, stories hold an estimate in days of work, and every date on the page is computed from what is still outstanding — nothing here is a hand-typed date (the CEO's ruling, 2026-09-04). Releases run in the order listed; each one's estimated date is the previous one's plus its own remaining work. A release with unestimated stories has no date, and neither does anything after it, because a chain built on a guess is worse than an honest blank. Seeded 2026-09-05: v0.2.0's stories are the real remaining requirements of its two critical projects; everything after it is a placeholder waiting to be sketched with the CEO.

releases.name: Player Update 1
releases.contains: The shop, and the first robot you can teach — the beginning of the delegation arc, plus eleven other things a player would notice.

releases.name: Machines that pay for themselves
releases.contains: Automation you place and maintain: sprinkler coverage and overlap, upkeep, and the resource loop behind buying a machine — plus the first group-pest skirmishes to spend it on.

releases.name: Towers and waves
releases.contains: The tower-defense slice. Towers that start out taking orders and end up running themselves, and waves designed against the simulation rather than by hand.

releases.name: A bot that learns from you
releases.contains: The first bot trained on your own recorded sessions, with the overnight training loop running on the tablet itself.

releases.name: The last phase
releases.contains: The genre and interface experiments that close the five-phase arc, then content and polish.
